'''2012 US Nationals Day 1 George (2012 US Nationals) LS Restore Freedom To The Galaxy''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[George (2012 US Nationals)|George]] at [[2012 US Nationals]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Restore Freedom To The Galaxy (Virtual Block 7)|VB7-L-restorefreedomtothegalaxy-pre.gif|label=Restore Freedom To The Galaxy}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
